repo_notes.content: This repository previously aggregated many public LiveKit repositories. The code has been moved out and this repo now serves as a redirect to docs.livekit.io, where users can use the 'Ask AI' feature to get answers about LiveKit SDKs, Agents, and all other LiveKit products. Direct all questions to https://docs.livekit.io/.

pages.title: LiveKit Documentation
pages.purpose: Redirect users to the official LiveKit documentation and its Ask AI feature

page_notes.content: All LiveKit SDK code, Agents framework code, client SDKs, server SDKs, and examples that were previously in this composite repo are now accessible through their individual repositories. For questions about any LiveKit product, use the Ask AI feature at https://docs.livekit.io/.
